'''Armen Rustamyan''' ({{langx|hy|Արմեն Ռուստամյան}}; born March 1, 1960) is an [[Politics of Armenia|Armenian politician]] from the [[Armenian Revolutionary Federation]]. He is a deputy in the [[National Assembly (Armenia)|National Assembly of Armenia]], first elected in 1999.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://parliament.am/deputies.php?ID=898&sel=details&lang=eng |title=National Assembly of Armenia |accessdate=July 11, 2015}}</ref>
